subject: Co-sell bundling: demo credits, trial SKUs, and private offer gating
messages:
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@elevatedata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-07T09:12:00Z
Subject: Marketplace listing + co-sell ask

Hi Ben,

Thanks again for the intro last week. ElevateData is ready to move our offering onto cloud marketplaces (AWS first, then GCP). A few things we want to align on so the listing and co-sell go smoothly: 

- Trial SKU model: we want a 14-day demo with baked-in credits and a follow-up conversion path. Do you have recommended SKU packaging patterns that play well with "Sell With"/co-sell qualification?
- Private offers / procurement gating: can Redwood provide guidance on private offer creation (eligibility, minimums) and co-sell contact routing?
- Technical evidence: we have architecture docs and a short integration guide (attached). What specific artifacts do your marketplace teams need for co-sell certification?

Attached: elevatedata-arch.pdf (high-level architecture)

Can we do a 30-min sync early next week to map the entitlement table? We are aiming to be live in AWS by end of Q4.

Best,
Lydia Chen
Head of Partnerships
ElevateData

---
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@elevatedata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-07T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell ask

Lydia — thanks for the clear list. Happy to help; welcome aboard. Quick notes before we kick off a working session: 

- Trial SKU recommendations: 14 days is fine. We typically map three SKUs: sandbox (free/demo credits), starter (pay-as-you-go hourly), and enterprise (private offer). For co-sell, the sandbox needs a clear conversion event (e.g., onboarded workspace + API calls > X). I can share a template entitlement matrix in the sync.
- Private offers: Redwood can assist with private offer packaging and the co-sell handoff. We coordinate the legal/minimums with the marketplace rep — Karthik will own the technical evidence and metering questions.
- Evidence: at minimum: architecture diagram, SOC2 statement (if available), integration guide, and a short telemetry sample. If you have a metered billing example (CSV), bring it to the meeting.

Propose Tuesday 09/09 at 10:00 PT — 30 minutes. If that works, I’ll send calendar invite and include our AWS marketplace contact.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192

On 2025-09-07 Lydia wrote:
> Thanks again for the intro last week. ElevateData is ready to move our offering onto cloud marketplaces (AWS first, then GCP).
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Lydia Chen <lydia@elevatedata.com>
Date: 2025-09-08T08:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell ask

Looping in details from the technical side. A few clarifying questions for the sync so we can come prepared: 

1) Metered billing: does ElevateData plan to use metered usage SKUs (per-inference-second / per-embedding-unit) or fixed-hourly VM SKUs?
2) Trial provisioning: can the sandbox be auto-provisioned via an API (preferred) or will it be a manual onramp that relies on a support ticket? Our co-sell flows favor auto-provisioning for qualification signals.
3) KV/telemetry: we'll need a short sample of the telemetry payload (traces/tokens-per-request) so we can validate cost-estimates and quantization guidance in our Optimize toolkit.

Also — if you have an expected procurement contact at the buyer side, share that. We’ll prepare the private-offer checklist and a starter private-offer template for AWS. 

Karthik
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

On 2025-09-07 Ben wrote:
> Propose Tuesday 09/09 at 10:00 PT — 30 minutes.
From: Lydia Chen <lydia@elevatedata.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-09T15:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell ask

Ben / Karthik — thanks for the quick turn. Tuesday at 10:00 PT works. Quick answers inline: 

1) Metering: We'll use metered billing for inference (per-token equivalent). We have a sample usage CSV and a simple pricing tier table (attached: trial-sku-table.csv).
2) Provisioning: Sandbox can be auto-provisioned via our onboarding API — we can hand over an API key and onboarding endpoint for the integration.
3) Telemetry: attaching a short sample (in the CSV) and a one-page JSON schema. SOC2 is in progress (expected Q1).

Procurement contact: maria.huang@elevatedata.com — she’ll join the sync if scheduling permits. Our target for a private offer (<$20k initial) is to catch a handful of early adopter deals in Q4.

Attaching: trial-sku-table.csv

Look forward to the call — will recap after.

Best,
Lydia

On 2025-09-08 Karthik wrote:
> Looping in details from the technical side. A few clarifying questions for the sync so we can come prepared:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lydia Chen <lydia@elevatedata.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-09-17T16:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing + co-sell ask — next steps and owners

Appreciate the call today. Summary & next steps: 

- Entitlement mapping: Karthik will take the trial-sku-table.csv and draft a Redwood entitlement mapping (expected by 2025-09-24). Action: Karthik to produce a recommended SKU mapping and a short note on conversion signals.
- Private offer template: Ben to share a private-offer template and intro to our AWS listing rep (I’ve looped the AWS contact in the calendar invite). Action: Ben to share DocuSign link for standard co-sell MSA/addendum.
- Technical evidence: ElevateData to provide SOC2 status (update as available), API onboarding key for auto-provisioning sandbox, and telemetry sample (already attached). Action: Lydia to upload SOC2 timeline and API docs to the shared Drive folder.
- Timeline: target AWS listing + co-sell enablement by 2025-11-30; private offers to follow for first set of pilot customers.

Links & artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-cosell-playbook
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/8421 (please update status and expected close)

Attachments: co-sell-playbook-v1.pdf (summary of Redwood’s co-sell signals and eligibility)

If there are procurement/legal redlines on the MSA, route to our Legal via legal@redwoodinference.com and copy me. Will follow up with the DocuSign link by tomorrow.

Thanks — good momentum here.

Ben Carter
Head of Alliances | Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0192
